# Capture operations

I start a capture operation on a capturable ship, alone or with my wing. My wingmen break its hull below the bail gate, then only keep its shields down, so the pilot bails instead of dying. Bail pressure and the checks the operation asks for are in bail-pressure.feature.

Source: [`tests/game/features/capture-operation.feature`](../../tests/game/features/capture-operation.feature) · Spec: [`docs/specs/capture-operation.md`](../specs/capture-operation.md)

| Unit tests | Game tests | Manual | Pending | By hand |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 15 | 1 | 2 | **3** |

## Scenarios

### An operation starts on a capturable fighter

**Automated:** in game `capture_start_and_destroyed`

```gherkin
  Given a capturable Imperial fighter with a pilot
  When I start a capture operation on it
  Then the operation starts
```

### An operation can't start on my own ship or twice on the same target

**Automated:** in game `capture_start_and_destroyed`

```gherkin
  Given a capture operation on a capturable fighter
  When I try to start an operation on one of my own ships
  And I try to start a second operation on the same fighter
  Then neither starts
```

### Losing the target ends the operation as destroyed

**Automated:** in game `capture_start_and_destroyed`

```gherkin
  Given a capture operation on a capturable fighter
  When the fighter is destroyed
  Then the operation ends as "destroyed"
```

### The operation ends when the pilot bails

**Automated:** in game `capture_abandoned`

```gherkin
  Given a capture operation on a capturable fighter
  When the fighter's pilot bails
  Then the operation ends as "abandoned"
  And the fighter is no longer part of an operation
  And no new operation can start on the now ownerless fighter
```

### A wingman stops firing once the target is inside the bail gate

**Automated:** in game `capture_wing_holds_fire`

```gherkin
  Given a capture operation on a capturable fighter with 80% hull and its shields kept down until the hull is below 75%
  And my wingman flies an X-wing with four lasers and no missiles
  When the wingman breaks the fighter's hull below 75%
  Then the wingman stops firing
  And for 30 seconds the hull stays below 75% and above 55%
  And the hull never drops below the 35% floor
  And the wingman keeps moving while it holds fire, never sitting still for 5 seconds
```

### A wingman that can't close in still stops the hull near the bail gate

**Automated:** in game `capture_wing_holds_fire_held_still`

```gherkin
  Given a capture operation on a capturable fighter with 80% hull and its shields kept down until the hull is below 75%
  And my wingman flies an X-wing with four lasers and no engines, held 2 km from the fighter and facing it
  When the wingman breaks the fighter's hull below 75%
  Then for 30 seconds the hull stays below 75% and above 55%
  And the hull never drops below the 35% floor
```

### Only one wingman of a wing finishes the break

**Automated:** in game `capture_wing_holds_fire_three_held_still`

```gherkin
  Given a capture operation on a capturable fighter with 80% hull and its shields kept down until the hull is below 75%
  And three wingmen fly X-wings with four lasers and no engines, held 2 km from the fighter around it
  When the wing breaks the fighter's hull below 75%
  Then only one wingman fires until the hull is below 75%
  And for 30 seconds the hull stays below 75% and above 55%
  And the hull never drops below the 35% floor
```

### The comm choice starts an operation

**Automated:** in game `capture_comm_choice`

```gherkin
  Given I'm flying a ship and hail the pilot of a capturable fighter
  When I choose "Heave to. We're taking your ship."
```

### Aborting the mission calls the wing off

**Automated:** in game `capture_abort_calls_wing_off`

```gherkin
  Given a capture operation with my wingman attacking
  When I abort the capture mission
  Then the operation ends as "called off"
  And the wingman stops attacking and returns to formation
```

### The comm choice and the mission's Abort work in SWI's menus

- [ ] **Manual:** checked by hand for now

```gherkin
  Given I'm playing on SWI, flying a ship with a wingman
  When I hail a capturable fighter and click "Heave to. We're taking your ship."
  Then a capture operation starts and its mission shows
  When I click Abort on that mission in SWI's mission menu
  Then the operation ends as "called off" and the wingman returns to formation
```

### The target escapes

**Automated:** in game `capture_escaped`

```gherkin
  Given a capture operation on a capturable fighter, with me close to it
  When nobody in the operation is within 15 km of it for 30 seconds

```

### Hailing from far away doesn't count as an escape

**Automated:** in game `capture_escape_waits_for_engagement`

```gherkin

  When nobody in the operation has been within 15 km of it yet
  Then the operation keeps running while we close in
```
